cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import urllib.request, urllib.parse, re
ids = re.findall(r"'id' => '([^']*)'", open('config/show-garden.php').read())
bad=[]
for i in ids:
    url='http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/sensors/'+urllib.parse.quote(i)+'/data'
    try:
        r=urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=30)
        code=r.status
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        code=e.code
    except Exception as e:
        code=str(e)
    if code!=200: bad.append((i,code))
print("total markers:",len(ids))
print("non-200:",bad)
EOF
